ns2:section.sectionText: This class is designed to expose students to the peer-review publication process. Topics covered will include how to choose an appropriate journal for an article, submission tactics, what is needed for submission, common mistakes that affect acceptance, approaching the revision process, and steps to take following rejection of a manuscript. The class will also cover the peer-review process from a reviewer?s perspective and will discuss the value of serving as a reviewer, deciding whether or not to review a paper, and how to provide an effective and objective peer-review.
